examples.en: From the slope below, the wild goats bleated faintly.
examples.zh: 野山羊在下面山坡上咩咩地轻声叫着。

examples.en: A herd of goats was nibbling the turf around the base of the tower.
examples.zh: 一群山羊正在啃着塔基周围的草皮。

examples.en: Vegetation patterns changed when goats were introduced to the island.
examples.zh: 自从引进山羊之后，这个岛上的植被模式改变了。
